items.issue: Tilemaps are bounded to 4,194,304 cells per component and 65,536 definitions; platform GPU/memory limits can be lower than the one-million-tile headless reference.
items.workaround: Split worlds into cells, enable chunk streaming, use Project Health/Profiler, and qualify the target GPU before shipping.

items.issue: WorldChunk memoryEstimateMb is an author-provided planning estimate, not an operating-system allocation measurement.
items.workaround: Use conservative estimates and compare them with Profiler memory captures on every target.

items.issue: The built-in web save backend is bounded to 10 MB per envelope and inherits browser/WebView storage quotas.
items.workaround: Use compact structured state and a custom serializer/backend for larger databases.

items.issue: This release run builds and qualifies Windows/WebView2 and Chromium on the named Windows host; clean Linux and macOS packaging remains a matching-host task.
items.workaround: Run the supplied release matrix on Linux and macOS before making matching-host installer claims.

items.issue: The automated world-data soak is accelerated; a 24-hour wall-clock game session is not falsely claimed.
items.workaround: Run the documented 24-hour workflow on named release hardware.
